about: A C# library for reading and writing zip, tar, 7z and other archive formats.

prs.title: Saved tar files keep each file's permissions
prs.broken: Saving a tar archive gave every file full permissions for everyone, so a private key packed as owner-only came out readable and writable by anyone after unpacking.
prs.changed: Each file and folder now keeps the permissions it had in the archive. New files still get the old default.
prs.matters: Private files stay private when archives are rewritten, for example in Docker images.

prs.title: Symlinked files are stored whole in tar archives
prs.broken: Adding a folder to a tar archive on Linux or macOS stored a symlinked file as just a few bytes, the length of the link path. tar unpacked it with no error, so the file was silently broken.
prs.changed: The size now comes from the file that was actually opened, so the full contents are stored.
prs.matters: Backups and packages that contain symlinks unpack with the real file contents.
